acceptance_scope: Figure protocol and visual inspection only; scientific gates are reported separately.
inspection_method: Every preview inspected on contact sheets, with full-size review of complex layouts and newly repaired summary figures. Titles, dates, axes, legends, dense data, source colors, empty regions, and clipping checked.
inspection_conventions: Scatter compares satellite and AERONET: quantity-only AOD title and source names on axes follow DAVINCI CLAUDE.md lines 813-823.
Southern Ocean is the region south of 40 degrees S, including land and islands; it is not an ocean-only surface mask.
